# Every message type omcid handles, once, against the entities it creates
# for itself: written by hand for the olt fuzz target (fuzz_olt.c), since the
# session fixtures are almost all Create, Set and Get. One 48-byte record a
# line; the CRC is left zero, the target computes it. Every value is made up.
#
# MIB reset, then the upload and the first records of it.
#
# expect: event=rejected class=256 op=test mt=18 result=not_supported
# expect: event=rejected class=2 op=14 mt=14 result=parameter_error
# expect: event=rejected class=2 op=12 mt=12 result=parameter_error
